why: The sun moved to where the two voxel targets put it, and six consumers still
carry the old one because they are LEGACY PHOTOREALISTIC BAKES: pictures and
manifests authored under elevation 34 / azimuth -9.5 that no tool in this
repository can re-author, because the chain that made them was removed in the
foundation. Failing on them would leave the guard red for the whole campaign,
and a guard that is always red is a guard nobody reads.
So each one is named here, with the session that will replace it and the fact
that it is going. tools/lighting/check-suns.mjs passes on exactly these and on
nothing else: a consumer that is not on this list and disagrees with the seat
still fails, which is the case the guard exists for. An id here that is not a
consumer the guard knows about also fails -- a typo in this file would be a
hole in the guard rather than a waiver.
Every line of this file is a debt. It shrinks, it never grows: adding an id
is a decision for the coordinator, and the session named beside one closes it
by re-authoring what it owns under the seat.
